summaries: Parkland's strongest imported academic metric is Future Ready math/algebra proficiency at 83.3% in 2024-2025.
Parkland is 4.7 percentage points higher than CIRCLE OF SEASONS CS on English Language Arts in the latest official file.
Pennsylvania statewide English Language Arts is 48.6%; Parkland reports 69.0% for the same subject in the imported PSSA file.
8 Pennsylvania cyber charter entities are included from Future Ready fast facts for category-level comparison.
